trigger.activation: explicit user selection of interface_water profile; never inferred from elements or file name alone
spec_conditions: user provides water O type, H type, water model, flexibility

renderer_extensions.description: emit fix shake only if user confirmed rigid classical water with bond and angle topology; never for MLFF flexible water
renderer_extensions.ordering: after all force-adding fixes, before integrator

renderer_extensions.description: declare RDF, z-density and water-count analysis outputs; do not auto-select thresholds

static_rules.description: water O and H type IDs must be explicitly declared by the user in profile_context
water model (SPC/E, TIP3P, TIP4P, flexible, MLFF) must be explicitly declared
water flexibility (rigid or flexible) must be explicitly declared
fix shake must not appear when water is MLFF flexible; SHAKE changes the model sampling space
fix shake requires bond and angle topology in the data file; only for user-confirmed rigid classical water
fix npt or nph must not barostat a non-periodic (vacuum) dimension
RDF, z-density and water-count outputs should be declared for interface water production

steps: run 0: check water molecule count and initial geometry
short NVT 50 to 100 steps: check water integrity, slab drift, no escape, no short contacts
verify RDF and z-density initial values are declared
checks: water molecule count conserved between read_data and final dump
no water atom escaped into the vacuum or slab region
minimum O-O distance above 2.0 Angstrom and O-H distance above 0.8 Angstrom
RDF, z-density and water-count output files generated

required_evidence.metric: plan to compare z-density profile against AIMD or experimental reference
plan to compare O-O and O-H RDF against AIMD or experimental reference
water count conserved and no fragmentation from a real LAMMPS run

unresolved_behavior.missing_fact: water O and H type IDs

outputs: RDF data (fix ave/time with compute rdf)
trajectory (dump custom id type x y z)
handoff_targets: post-processing skill for hydrogen-bond and orientation analysis (MDAnalysis or OVITO)
